profile.headline: Web Developer at Crescendo Interactive
profile.summary:
Hello, I'm Jair, Im a computer science enthusiast with close to a decade of programming experience. My journey began in high school, and since then, I've developed a passion for creating games and working on various side projects.

I am currently a Web Developer for Crescendo Interactive where I fix and create websites for charities!

Some of my favorite things to program are games I've made two so far in a group. For both I was responsible for the art and programming functionality. For one I 3D modeled the weapons and programing their logic and damage. For the other i programmed the UI menus. In addition I love programming Python scripts at my Catalog Developer job I programmed a script for my boss that automates the Catalog archive process.

My ultimate career aspiration is to join Riot Games (I main Clove in Valorant), where I can combine my skills and passion to contribute to their innovative and dynamic environment.

projects.title: Sundered Realms
projects.description: Sundered Realms is a first person shooter, roguelike, dungeon crawler made in Roblox. This was a Senior Design project with my groupmates that took us a full school year to complete. I was in charge of the 3D models, 3D animations, and programming the weapons functionality.

projects.title: Spotify Song Recommendation
projects.description: Designed and implemented a personalized music recommendation engine using Python. Extracted and processed track metadata via the Spotify API, then applied and optimized the Alternating Least Squares (ALS) algorithm to generate tailored playlist suggestions based on user listening patterns.
